# 504 — Dependency_ResolutionFailed

Reports that an attempt to locate, load, or construct a requested application component failed\.

[All events](index.md) · [Dependency category](Category_Dependency.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.DependencyEvents.ResolutionFailed%28System.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.Exception%29)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| EventId | 504 |
| Name | Dependency_ResolutionFailed |
| Category | [Dependency](Category_Dependency.md) |
| Event class | UnrecoverableWarning |

| Introduced | 0.0.9 |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.Dependency.ResolutionFailed(@dependencyName, @operationName, @resolutionId, @reasonCode, @exception);
```

**Trigger:** Emit when an attempted component resolution cannot supply the requested component\.

**Message template:** Dependency resolution failed\. Dependency: \{DependencyName\}\. Operation: \{OperationName\}\. Resolution: \{ResolutionId\}\. Reason: \{ReasonCode\}\.

## Arguments

- `dependencyName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical name of the component being resolved\.
- `operationName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical operation requiring the component\.
- `resolutionId` (`string`): The unique identifier of this resolution attempt\. Use a new identifier for each retry\.
- `reasonCode` (`string`): A stable application\-defined classification, such as NotFound, LoadFailed, or ConstructionFailed\.
- `exception` (`Exception?`): The original exception when appropriate for the logging destination, or null when no exception occurred or its details must not be logged\.

## Remarks

- A dependency is an application component, such as a plugin, implementation, or locally loaded provider\. This event is not limited to a dependency injection container\.
- The absence of an optional component is not automatically a failure\. Emit when an actual attempt to resolve the requested component fails\.
- Configuration source loading and parsing failures belong to Configuration\_LoadFailed\. An operation encountering an unavailable external service belongs to External\_ServiceUnavailable\.
- A successful resolution followed by a failure while using the component is not a resolution failure\.
- Report once at the boundary responsible for the attempt\. Do not report the same failure again at each calling layer\.
- Use a small documented set of ReasonCode values\. Do not include credentials, configuration contents, sensitive paths, or raw exception messages in structured arguments\.
- Pass the original exception only when appropriate for the logging destination\. Do not manufacture an exception solely for logging\.
- The exception travels through the logging exception channel and is not a message\-template property\.
- Cancellation and application shutdown are not dependency resolution failures\.
- The application may select a fallback, disable a feature, or stop\. A resolution failure does not automatically establish degraded application mode\.
- A later successful resolution does not by itself establish recovery to normal application mode\.
- Calling this method only emits a diagnostic record\. It does not resolve components, retry, select a fallback, change application mode, or initiate shutdown\.
